events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n "content" app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts | grep -i "id:" | head -20; ls app/scripts | grep -E "check-guides|probe-details|probe-onboarding-tabs|probe-headings|probe-visual-tools"; grep -n '"check-guides\|"probe-details\|"probe-onboarding-tabs\|"probe-headings\|"probe-visual-tools' app/package.json

events.name: Bash

events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n "d3-content-loop" app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts app/src/lib/card-education.ts docs/onboarding-v3/coverage.json | head -5; sed -n 2050,2060p app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts; grep -n "showIf\|when:" app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts | sed -n '1,0p'; awk 'NR>=2050 && NR<=2160' app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts | grep -n "showIf\|visibleIf\|when" ; head -30 app/scripts/probe-details.mjs | grep -n "localhost\|PORT\|BASE"

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check server and probe args
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; lsof -ti:4361 | head -2; grep -n '"dev"\|"build"\|"preview"' package.json; for f in check-guides probe-onboarding-tabs probe-headings probe-visual-tools; do echo "== $f"; grep -n "argv\[2\]\|BASE =" scripts/$f.mjs | head -2; done

events.text: The content cards from commit d6d2b323 are already on main. Next I'm running the five probes against a local dev server.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check running servers and run check-guides
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; (curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} 4361\n" http://127.0.0.1:4361/tantra-workshop-live; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} 4322\n" http://localhost:4322/debug/onboarding); grep -n "basePath\|port" next.config.* | head; node scripts/check-guides.mjs 2>&1 | tail -8

events.name: Bash

events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; for f in probe-headings probe-visual-tools probe-details; do echo "== $f"; grep -n "http://\|process.argv" scripts/$f.mjs | head -3; done; cat ../.claude/launch.json | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start dev server, run static probes
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; nohup npx next dev -p 4322 > /tmp/t467-dev.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/t467-dev.pid; node scripts/probe-details.mjs - 2>&1 | tail -6; node scripts/probe-visual-tools.mjs 2>&1 | tail -6

events.name: Bash

events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:4322/debug/onboarding | grep -q 200 && break; sleep 3; done; echo ready; node scripts/probe-onboarding-tabs.mjs 2>&1 | tail -6; node scripts/probe-headings.mjs 2>&1 | tail -6
